entries.title: Psalms 36:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. [A Psalm] of the servant of Jehovah; of David.>> The transgression of the wicked uttereth within my heart, There is no fear of God before his eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 36:2
segments: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, [even] when his iniquity is found to be hateful.

entries.title: Psalms 36:3
segments: The words of his mouth are wickedness and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, to do good.

entries.title: Psalms 36:4
segments: He deviseth wickedness up on his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good: he abhorreth not evil.

entries.title: Psalms 36:5
segments: ¶Jehovah, thy loving-kindness is in the heavens, and thy faithfulness [reacheth] unto the clouds.

entries.title: Psalms 36:6
segments: Thy righteousness is like the high mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: thou, Jehovah, preservest man and beast.

entries.title: Psalms 36:7
segments: How precious is thy loving-kindness, O God! So the sons of men take refuge under the shadow of thy wings.

entries.title: Psalms 36:8
segments: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou wilt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

entries.title: Psalms 36:9
segments: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

entries.title: Psalms 36:10
segments: Continue thy loving-kindness unto them that know thee, and thy righteousness to the upright in heart;

entries.title: Psalms 36:11
segments: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.

entries.title: Psalms 36:12
segments: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and are not able to rise.
